hero.description: GREETINT turns a birthday into a premium digital experience — a personal quest with hidden secrets, unlockable memories, a candle to blow out, and a final capsule for the future.

tabs.receiverTitle: An experience, not just a wish
tabs.receiverText: The birthday person scans the QR code, breaks the wax seal, scratches off the secret joke, answers a question to unlock the photos, blows out the candle on their screen, and fills in their own 7 answers for the future.
tabs.giverTitle: Put together a personalized gift in minutes
tabs.giverText: Fill in 3 quick personal details, pick from our ready-made playful lines (or write your own), upload your favorite photos, and write your wish. Everything else falls into place automatically.

selectStyle.title: Choose a Birthday Style
selectStyle.subtitle: Each style offers a unique visual aesthetic, themed animations, and an engaging quest for the recipient.
